description: What Figma can't hold. `figma` sets how a Figma variable is written in CSS: the font stacks, and ease/spring's curve, Figma's spring (bounce 0.15, a 0.85 damping ratio) sampled over its run, since CSS has no spring; `tokens` adds code-only tokens. `{figma/name}` pulls a Figma variable's raw value in for each theme. Shadows aren't here: they're Figma's Shadow/* effect styles, exported to src/figma/effect-styles.json.
